info.title: justi.fun API
info.description: Public API for justi.fun, a Solana launchpad on Meteora DBC. Read coins, trades and rewards, quote and build swaps on the curve and on the DAMM v2 pool after graduation, build launches, and get webhooks and live streams. Amounts that can exceed 2^53 are decimal strings. Times are unix seconds. Errors are {error:{code,message,details?}}. Live streams: GET /v1/stream (SSE) and the WebSocket at /v1/ws (see x-websocket).

post.summary: Relay a signed swap built by POST /v1/swap
post.description: Checks it is paid and signed by the building wallet and carries the exact swap instruction built, then sends it (RPC rebroadcast every 2s, plus Jito when built with a tip) until confirmed, failed or expired. Answers when it settles or after waitMs (default 20000, max 25000) with status submitted; poll GET /v1/tx/{signature}. A trade that fails on chain is a 200 with status failed and an error.

post.summary: Build a launch exactly like the site does
post.description: Same validation as the site: copy rule, 15% dev-buy cap, tier configs, sniper window, 10 launches per wallet a day. Returns an unsigned (by the wallet) v0 create transaction. signers lists every required signature: the payer (wallet) always; the mint is already signed for pool keys, or must be signed by your client with your custom mint keypair. Then POST /v1/launches/{id}/submit with the fully signed transaction within about a minute.

post.summary: Register a webhook (the secret is shown once)
post.description: Deliveries are POSTs of {id,type,createdAt,data} with headers Justi-Event, Justi-Delivery and Justi-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>. Any 2xx is success. Retries: 8 attempts, 30s x 3^(n-1) (cap 6h, +-20% jitter). 25 failures in a row disable the webhook. trade events can be limited to mints.
